summary: Frontend-only verification of /comprovante.html receipt rendering after inline script injection. Seeded sessionStorage 'inscricaoDados' via Playwright add_init_script for two scenarios: (1) two inscriptions with segundaInscricao='Sim', (2) single inscription. All assertions passed.

issues: Legacy 'Concurso:' label with dash value still renders at top of the receipt table (not part of this fix scope, but visually redundant now that 1ª/2ª Inscrição sections carry the details). Consider hiding it.

critical_code_review_comments: Inline script correctly falls back to localStorage and to d.cargo/d.cidadeProva when needed - good defensive coding.
Optional cleanup: remove or hide the empty 'Concurso:' row at the top of the receipt to avoid duplicated/empty section context.
seed_data_creation: Seeded sessionStorage 'inscricaoDados' JSON per spec (both two-inscription and single-inscription variants).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.add_init_script to seed sessionStorage BEFORE goto, then read document.body.innerText to assert labels/values. Both scenarios asserted: 1ª Inscrição header + NRE (IRATI) + Municípios (FERNANDES PINHEIRO, GUAMIRANGA) + Prova + Função (renamed from Cargo) + Local de Prova (MARINGÁ); with segundaInscricao='Sim' also 2ª Inscrição header + NRE (CURITIBA) + Municípios (SETOR BOQUEIRÃO) + Prova (Gestão de Negócios) + Função (GN - Recursos Humanos). Heading now reads 'Seletivos' (previously 'Concursos').
rca of the issue: Fix verified working: appended <script> locates the 'Cargo:' <td>, renames it to 'Função:', and injects the missing rows before/after using insertBefore. Handles segundaInscricao='Sim' branch and always appends Local de Prova at the end.
